title: Front kick, learned from its video alone
tagline: No kick-specific reward: the clip's four key moments became the task, and all three completed it (6/6) with no falls; the warm start managed 1/6.

story.shown: The front-kick phone video, retargeted to G1 proportions. keypose.py picked its four key moments: (1) right foot up, right foot forward; (2) right foot down, right foot back; (3) right foot up, right foot right; (4) right foot down, right foot left.
story.learned: Tracking, Task and Task (no reference) policies, each warm-started from the squat-jump weights and trained 1,500 iterations. The reward is the same spec any clip compiles to; nothing in it is about kicking.
story.how: A stage checker reads only the robot's own body: the kicking foot reaching each key pose in order, feet on the floor where the clip has them, no fall; the task policies did it 0.5–0.8 m (mean torso distance) away from the clip's own path.

policies.label: Tracking
policies.reward: Copies the retarget's joint angles (the standard motion-imitation reward).

policies.label: Task
policies.reward: Rewarded for reaching the clip's key moments in order (keypose spec), plus weak V-JEPA 2 and tracking style terms. Sees the retarget. Ends only on a fall.

policies.label: Task (no reference)
policies.reward: The same keypose reward, but the policy never sees the retarget: only its own body, a clock and the current stage.
